transcript: Speaker A: मेरा पोता लंदन में रहता है। वीडियो कॉल करता है, इंग्लिश में बोलता है। मैं बस मुस्कुराती हूँ और हाँ-हाँ करती हूँ... [My grandson lives in London and speaks English. I couldn't understand him and felt bad when I couldn't read him a story. I downloaded English Seekho app for a 1 rupee trial. I practiced 15 minutes daily with the AI coach. Now I can speak English with him and he calls me daily. If a 63-year-old can learn, so can you.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer [English Seekho, Install Now, Disclaimer]
summary: A 63-year-old grandmother explains how she used the English Seekho app to learn English so she could talk to her grandson in London. She encourages others to download the app, emphasizing that age is not a barrier.
